2607.27604.title: Revisiting the Adversarial Robustness of Graph-Based Traffic Forecasting
2607.27604.paper_summary: Traffic forecasting by graph-based AI is a critical component of intelligent transportation systems, motivating security research on robustness to malicious sensor readings. We argue that prior robustness evaluations are largely shaped by unrealistic threat models and untargeted objectives, so both attacks and defenses must be revisited. We study a practical adversary with limited model knowledge and the ability to monitor and manipulate only a few road sensors. More importantly, practical attacks can be localized to specific links or routes, causing incorrect estimated arrival times or unnecessary rerouting while leaving the broader network largely unaffected. This targeted setting remains underexplored, and defenses such as adversarial training do not transfer well from the norm-bounded attacks they train on to structurally different, physics-aware attacks that mimic genuine congestion. We therefore reframe robustness as a detection problem, introducing a learned physics-informed detector whose output is fed to a hardened forecaster as an input feature and trained against adaptive attacks with the forecaster fixed. We evaluate across a variety of model architectures and benchmarks. The physics-aware attack multiplies target-link error several-fold while the network-wide error barely moves, and adversarial training, tuned to norm-bounded perturbations, barely dents it. Our detection--mitigation defense improves even on adversarial training hardened against the physics-aware attack itself, on $13$ of $15$ model--dataset settings and by the widest margin on a held-out attack, at near-zero clean cost. The results emphasize the need to examine abstracted AI adversarial attacks under application-specific constraints to assess their true security impacts.
2607.27604.paper_summary_zh: 交通預測透過基於圖形的人工智慧是智能交通系統的一個關鍵組成部分，這促使了對於惡意感測器讀數的穩健性研究。我們認為，先前的穩健性評估在很大程度上受到不切實際的威脅模型和無針對性的目標的影響，因此攻擊和防禦都必須重新檢視。我們研究了一個實際的對手，該對手對模型的知識有限，並且只能監控和操控少數幾個道路感測器。更重要的是，實際攻擊可以被局部化到特定的鏈接或路徑，導致錯誤的預估到達時間或不必要的重新路由，同時對整體網絡的影響則相對較小。這種針對性的情境仍然未被充分探討，而像對抗性訓練這樣的防禦措施，從它們所訓練的範圍界限攻擊轉移到結構上不同、具物理意識的攻擊（這些攻擊模仿真實的擁堵）時效果不佳。因此，我們將穩健性重新框架為一個檢測問題，引入一個學習的物理知識檢測器，其輸出作為輸入特徵餵給一個加固的預測器，並在固定預測器的情況下對抗自適應攻擊進行訓練。我們在各種模型架構和基準上進行評估。具物理意識的攻擊將目標鏈接的錯誤乘以數倍，而整個網絡的錯誤幾乎沒有變化，對抗性訓練對於範圍界限的擾動幾乎沒有影響。我們的檢測-緩解防禦在對抗性訓練加固的情況下，即使面對具物理意識的攻擊，仍然在$15$個模型-數據集設置中的$13$個上有所改善，並且在一個保留的攻擊上以最寬的幅度提高，幾乎沒有清潔成本。這些結果強調了在特定應用約束下檢查抽象的人工智慧對抗攻擊以評估其真正安全影響的必要性。
2607.27604.author: Qingzhao Zhang et.al.
